adjust.title: Bonuses and penalties
adjust.subtitle: Give extra {{units}}, or take some away. A penalty lowers the {{units}} earned, so it can cost a rank, but it never takes the balance below zero.

presets.title: Presets
presets.subtitle: The usual bonuses and penalties, one touch away here and on the tablet.
presets.name: Name, for example "Tidy bedroom"
presets.pointsHelp: A positive number for a bonus, negative for a penalty (between -1000 and 1000).
presets.deleteMessage: Delete "{{name}}"? The {{units}} history stays as it is.
presets.failed: The preset could not be saved.

today.title: Today's games
today.streakRule_one: Every day in a row with at least one task done: +{{points}} {{units}} every {{count}} day.
today.streakRule_other: At least one task done every day for {{count}} days in a row: +{{points}} {{units}}, then again every {{count}} days.

periods.title: Bonus periods
periods.subtitle: During a bonus period, task {{units}} are multiplied.
periods.name: Name, for example "Double weekend"
periods.failed: The bonus period could not be saved.

rules.title: Game rules
rules.subtitle: The family's streaks and surprise tasks.
rules.help: 0 days or 0 {{units}} turns the streak bonus off; streaks are still counted. The surprise task is drawn each day among today's tasks that everyone can see.
rules.failed: The rules could not be saved.

ranks.title: Ranks
ranks.toStar_one: {{count}} more {{unit}} to a ⭐ star and a new round
ranks.toStar_other: {{count}} more {{units}} to a ⭐ star and a new round
ranks.settingsSubtitle: Steps of {{units}} earned since the start, from the first rank to the last.
ranks.name: Rank name
ranks.help: Ranks follow the {{units}} earned since the start: spending never lowers them, a penalty does. The first rank starts at 0 {{units}}. The last rank lasts as many {{units}} as the gap from the rank before, then gives a ⭐ star and a new round from the first rank. “Use the Hopla ranks” fills the list with the drawn ranks of the tribe: save to keep them.
ranks.failed: The ranks could not be saved.

quests.title: Quests
quests.subtitle: Drawn every Monday for the week, and on the 1st for the month.
quests.none: No quest running. Parents prepare the quest list below.
quests.listSubtitle: Weekly quests are drawn at random from this list; monthly ones go to everyone who can do them.
quests.deleteMessage: Delete "{{name}}"? If it is running, it goes on until the end of its week or month.
quests.failed: The quest could not be saved.

challenges.title: Challenges
challenges.subtitle: A goal between two dates, each on their own or as a family.
challenges.rewardText: Shared reward, such as "Swimming pool trip" (optional)
challenges.failed: The challenge could not be saved.

reset.title: Reset
reset.subtitle: Sets a member's {{units}}, or everyone's, back to zero, and so to the first rank. For example once a year, or after testing.
reset.help: Unchecked, the {{units}} history is kept and a "Reset" row is added. Streaks start over from zero. "Also put the tasks done back to do" erases the task history (done today, tasks in the journal) and puts each task done back to do, with the due date it had before; archived one-time tasks come back. Quests done and challenges won stay counted so they do not pay twice. "Also clear the games" erases games played, their stats and learning progress; game settings stay.
reset.confirmKeep: {{who}}: {{units}}, rank and streak back to zero. The history is kept.
reset.confirmClear: {{who}}: {{units}}, rank and streak back to zero, and {{units}} history erased. This cannot be undone.
reset.clearTaskHistory: Also put the tasks done back to do
reset.confirmTasks: The tasks done go back to do, with the due date they had before, and their history is erased.
reset.clearGames: Also clear the games and their stats
reset.confirmGames: Games played, their stats and what was learned are erased; the games start over. Game settings stay.

routines.title: Routines
routines.subtitle: Tasks done in order, one step at a time
routines.name: Routine name (e.g. Morning)
routines.help: Each child only sees the step to do. Tasks that are not theirs that day are skipped. The bonus is given once a day, when all their steps are done.
routines.empty: No routine yet. A routine chains existing tasks, such as getting dressed, teeth, then school bag.
routines.deleteMessage: “{{name}}” will be deleted. Its tasks stay.
